document_revision_meaning: This mount contract is regenerated with every package revision and carries the package revision as its own. R1.1 below refers to the accepted Phase 2C-min adapter it derives from, which this package does not modify.

authority.adapter: Accepted Phase 2C-min R1.1 conversational Typeform RFQ adapter. This contract decides WHERE the accepted interface mounts on the public estate and WHAT route-level context it may carry. It does not modify the adapter.
authority.scope_limit: Phase 2C-min R1.1 may inform mount and placement. It does not authorise any Typeform account, form, recipient, notification or live-form change, and no live submission is made or implied by this package.
authority.routes: PUBLIC_ROUTE_REGISTRY.tsv. BUILD is architectural intent only. A mount activates only where publication_ready = PUBLICATION_READY for its own route AND for the RFQ fallback route.
authority.design: Design R1.2 governs the presentation of the action. It contributes no route and no conversion decision.

standing_position: The accepted conversational Typeform RFQ interface IS the public conversion path. Nothing in this package suppresses, restricts, replaces or duplicates it. The prohibition carried through the navigation and content contracts is on inventing or exposing telephone, email or unrelated live-chat paths, none of which is held by any authority.

viewport_precedence.rule: Exactly one signal-colour RFQ action may be visible in any viewport at any time. Precedence, highest first: header_action, then the surface inline mount (product_detail_primary, category_and_family, editorial_inline, project_inline or rfq_page), then sticky_floating, then footer_rfq_band.
viewport_precedence.lower_precedence_treatment: A lower-precedence mount either does not render while a higher-precedence signal-colour action is in the viewport, or renders in a neutral treatment. It never renders a second signal-colour action.
viewport_precedence.sticky_suppression: sticky_floating is suppressed while the inline product action or the footer RFQ band is in the viewport, which is what makes its trigger condition - the hero having scrolled out - correct.
viewport_precedence.single_intent: One intent, one label: "Request a Quote" everywhere it appears.

loading_and_fallback.dialog_loading: LAZY: the embed is not requested until the action is invoked.
loading_and_fallback.no_script_fallback: Every mount carries a direct-link fallback to the RFQ route, which must itself be classified BUILD.
loading_and_fallback.direct_link: The form URL is resolvable as a direct link for a viewer without scripting.
loading_and_fallback.pre_staging_validation: Real-browser validation of the direct iframe against a non-production Typeform remains required before staging, as the accepted 2C-min R1.1 states.

route_coverage.mount_activation_condition: EVERY mount is inactive until its own route is publication-ready AND the RFQ fallback route is publication-ready.

rules: A mount renders only where its route carries publication_ready = PUBLICATION_READY in PUBLIC_ROUTE_REGISTRY.tsv. BUILD is an architectural state and never mounts anything.
No mount is active while the RFQ page / direct-link fallback route is not itself publication-ready, because a viewer without scripting would otherwise be sent to a page that may not publish.
The accepted adapter stays unmounted until both conditions above hold and the real-browser validation against a non-production Typeform has passed.
Context carries only keys on the adapter allowlist. A key outside it is dropped by the adapter, and this contract proposes none.
Configuration resolves fail-closed: a missing or malformed form id or origin renders no interactive element rather than pointing anywhere unverified.
No form id, origin, hidden-field mapping, notification recipient or analytics destination is invented, proposed or changed here.
No page renders a telephone number, email address or unrelated live-chat widget beside the RFQ interface, because no such contact fact is held by any accepted authority.
No private contact data appears in any mount, context key, example or log.
The direct iframe still requires real-browser validation against a non-production Typeform before staging, as the accepted 2C-min R1.1 states.
not_authorised_by_this_contract: Any Typeform account, workspace or form change

owner_decisions_required: SUPPLIED AS CONFIGURATION, STILL NOT ACTIVE: the production Typeform form id and origin are now supplied by the owner and recorded in current_state_overlay below. Supplying the identity does not mount it and does not make any route publication-ready.
Confirmation that the RFQ page route /contact-us/ is the intended no-script fallback.
Real-browser validation of the direct iframe against a non-production form before staging.

historical_frozen_layer.rule: This frozen evidence is historical and is preserved unchanged. The current state overlay does not clear it, reinterpret it or reduce its count.

current_state_layer.identity_value_rule: The form id and the canonical embed origin are carried verbatim as supplied. Neither is altered, shortened, replaced by a test or example value, nor widened to an additional origin.

current_state_overlay.reconciled_statement: The RFQ configuration identity IS supplied: form id F22cAgx3 on the canonical embed origin https://form.typeform.com, against the accepted Phase 2C-min R1.1 adapter. It is NOT active. Activation remains blocked by three independent conditions: the mount state is UNMOUNTED, no route and no RFQ fallback route is publication-ready, and real-browser validation against a non-production form has not been performed. It is therefore false to say no RFQ destination or form identity exists, and equally false to say the conversion path is resolved.
activation_blockers: MOUNT_STATE=UNMOUNTED: no mount is instantiated on any route by this package.
ROUTE_READINESS=0 publication-ready routes, so no mount can activate.
FALLBACK_READINESS=the RFQ fallback route is not publication-ready.
CONTROL_TOWER_ACCEPTANCE=not granted. STAGING = LOCKED. PRODUCTION = LOCKED.
not_changed_by_this_overlay: No Typeform account, workspace, form, question or setting is read, created or changed.
No notification recipient, CRM destination or email address is recorded anywhere in this package.
No live or test submission is made.
No mount is activated and no route becomes publication-ready.
No frozen Sprint4P R2 product gate state is cleared.
current_state_overlay.private_data_excluded: Only the non-private configuration identity is recorded: the public form URL, the form id and the canonical embed origin. No notification recipient, no CRM endpoint and no contact person appears in this package.
